## B03 audit

**Scope and citations.** The archive is `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/work/scene_archive/bundles/ablation_r1--ours_without_regression_guidance.tar.gz`. Member paths below are relative to `experiments/scene_rsi_pilot/` inside that archive. These are selected records, not the full archive; no images or underlying student trajectories are supplied.

**Detection and diagnosis.** The initial teacher plan reports a reference/render metric disagreement for `commons_109923183`, target `arm gold-1`, with code location unknown. Camera framing and object scale are explicitly hypotheses, not attributed causes. The pre-proposal plan requested two probes and is recorded as actually used; functional regression guidance was withheld (`candidates/ablation_r1/ours_without_regression_guidance/C1/meta_execution.json`, `plan.diagnoses`, `plan.probes`, `actually_used_for_proposal`, characters [0,2102)).

Both probes are recorded completed with one render attempt each. Focal length changed 51 to 56.1 with geometry unchanged; overall metric changed approximately 0.39075 to 0.38753. Scaling the selected nine-mesh group by 1.1 about its AABB center, with fixed camera and preserved non-targets, changed overall approximately 0.39075 to 0.39096. These are local metric observations, not proof of a visual cause or whole-object scale. C2 records essentially the same interventions with small numerical differences (`candidates/ablation_r1/ours_without_regression_guidance/C1/diagnostic_observations.json`, `probes[*].result`, `visual_metrics`, `baseline_visual_metrics`, characters [0,4071); C2 counterpart, same keys, [0,4069)).

**Proposed changes versus execution.** C1's proposal attributes failed first and second development executions to invalid fillet radii and a missing Blender world; it also claims a repeated sibling key replaced objects, and describes a pillow-group coverage disagreement whose omission versus cropping is unresolved. The supplied excerpt contains these claims, not the underlying tracebacks or student programs, so their details cannot be independently checked here. The proposal says no independent execution, rendering or evaluation was performed (`candidates/ablation_r1/ours_without_regression_guidance/C1/proposal_result.json`, `rationale`, `diagnosis`, `scope`, `status`, characters [0,23934)). Thus technical failures should not be conflated with measured visual quality or with demonstrated omissions.

The proposed shared H (`system.txt`, embedded in the same proposal, `files[path=system.txt].content`) calls for visible-object inventories, unique keys, semantic hierarchies, explicit support anchors, post-transform contact review, camera-pose/focal separation, and economical procedural surface detail. Material instructions include descendant-based edits and copying shared materials. These are instructions, not evidence of actual texture fidelity, pose, physical contact, lighting quality or student compliance. AABB relations are explicitly approximate. C1's proposed M triages all supplied scenes and existing probes, conserves the two-attempt diagnostic budget and preserves unknown mappings; C2 retains the initial planner, which selects the first complete scene and computes functional failure counts even though it returns no regression priorities (`candidates/ablation_r1/ours_without_regression_guidance/C1/meta.py`, `plan`, [0,7317); C2/meta.py, `plan`, [0,2797)).

C1's policy code would execute a returned program, treat `ok` plus an image as a successful render, provide failure-specific repair feedback otherwise, and allow selection only among successful steps. That is a mechanism specification, not evidence it ran on any particular student trajectory (`candidates/ablation_r1/ours_without_regression_guidance/C1/policy.py`, `solve`, [0,4646)).

**Acceptance evidence and limits.** The seven supplied C1 functional summaries—two development, two selection and three test—each report `structure_pass`, `material_pass`, `composite_pass` and `functional_pass` true. Each says the expected composite is required and its absence counts as failure; the summaries characterize the result as structural/edit operability only. `semantic_object_completeness` and `support_collision_truth` are null, so these passes do not establish complete multi-object coverage, correct material appearance or physical support (`results/ablation_r1/ours_without_regression_guidance/C1/{development/commons_109923183,development/commons_118588033,selection/commons_133800864,selection/commons_138420790,test/commons_155212263,test/commons_16007442,test/commons_163096530}/functional/summary.json`, keys above, respectively characters [0,360), [0,357), [0,352), [0,357), [0,350), [0,355), [0,357)).

The proposal states that final objectives and functional gates remain external and unchanged, but these selected records provide no overall candidate-acceptance decision or full threshold rule. Functional passes alone therefore do not substantiate overall acceptance or a visual-quality improvement.
